Here are some well-known office furniture brand websites where you can explore their products:

1. **Herman Miller**  
   Website: [hermanmiller.com](https://www.hermanmiller.com)  
   Known for innovative, high-quality office chairs and workstations.

2. **Steelcase**  
   Website: [steelcase.com](https://www.steelcase.com)  
   Offers a wide range of office furniture solutions focused on ergonomics.

3. **Haworth**  
   Website: [haworth.com](https://www.haworth.com)  
   Specializes in adaptable office furniture and collaborative spaces.

4. **Knoll**  
   Website: [knoll.com](https://www.knoll.com)  
   Famous for modern, stylish office furniture and seating.

5. **Allsteel**  
   Website: [allsteeloffice.com](https://www.allsteeloffice.com)  
   Provides contemporary office furniture and workspace solutions.

6. **HON**  
   Website: [hon.com](https://www.hon.com)  
   Offers durable and budget-friendly office furniture products.

7. **Teknion**  
   Website: [teknion.com](https://www.teknion.com)  
   Focuses on collaborative and dynamic work environments.

8. **Autonomous**  
   Website: [autonomous.ai](https://www.autonomous.ai)  
   Known for smart office furniture, including standing desks and ergonomic chairs.

If you are looking for something specific or regional, I can help find more tailored recommendations!
